Mud-Slap (Japanese: どろかけ Mud Spray) is a damage-dealing Ground-type move introduced in Generation II. It was TM31 in Generation II.

Effect

Generation II

Mud-Slap inflicts damage and has a 99.6% chance of lowering the target's accuracy stat by one stage.

Generation III onwards

Mud-Slap now always lowers the target's accuracy by one stage.

In Pokémon Legends: Arceus, Mud-Slap inflicts damage and obscures the user, making attacks targeting the user more likely to miss.

Mud-Slap can be used as the first move of a Pokémon Contest combination, causing Mud Sport and Sand-Attack to score double the normal appeal if used in the next turn. It can also be used to finish a combination, with the user gaining 2 bonus appeal points if Mud Sport, Sand-Attack, or Sandstorm was used in the previous turn.

In other games

Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series

In Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team and Explorers of Time, Darkness and Sky, Mud-Slap is a move with 4 base power, 84% accuracy, and 16 PP. The user attacks enemy in the front, cutting corners, and lowers their accuracy by one level.

In the anime

Barbaracle Murkrow Drilbur Krookodile
The user hurls mud in the foe's face.
Pokémon Method
User First Used In Notes

Three wild Murkrow All That Glitters! Debut

Nanu's Krookodile Tough Guy Trials! None
